name: codex-local-video-studio
description: Create evidence-backed motion-graphics videos locally on Windows and Linux.

interface.shortDescription: Research, narrate, render, and validate local videos.
interface.longDescription: Turns a topic, post, article, or storyboard into an evidence-backed MP4 with motion graphics, offline narration, procedural BGM, subtitles, editorial review, media QC, and safe cleanup on Windows or Linux.
defaultPrompt: Turn this article into a polished 60-second vertical explainer.
Research this topic and create an evidence-backed science video.
Create a local motion-graphics video from this storyboard.
